Package neqsim.process.equipment.separator.entrainment

Class ZeroCarryOverProvider

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.separator.entrainment.ZeroCarryOverProvider
All Implemented Interfaces:
EnhancedEntrainmentProvider
public class ZeroCarryOverProvider extends Object implements EnhancedEntrainmentProvider
Entrainment model that reports no carry-over at all.

Registered as "zero". Use it when carry-over is known to be negligible, when isolating another effect in a study, or as a deliberate baseline against which another model is compared. It is always applicable because it makes no claim about the separator.

This is an assumption, not a prediction: it returns zero regardless of gas load, internals or overload. A separator running far beyond its capacity still reports zero carry-over under this model.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim

      public String getId()

      Examples: "neqsim-7stage" (built-in), "eqn-pi-v1" (Equinor private plug-in v1), "eqn-pi-v2" (v2). The id is the argument to Separator.setEntrainmentProvider(String).

    • getVersion

      public String getVersion()
      Returns the version string of this provider.

      Recommended format: semantic versioning, e.g. "1.0.0". The version is recorded on the EntrainmentResult so plant historians and reports can tag which method produced a number.
